all_candidates.topic: Should E20 policy be reviewed due to rising food prices?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Congress on August 21, 2026, demanded E20 policy review, citing increased food prices and fuel expenses.

all_candidates.topic: Should consumers pay no MDR on UPI transactions?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman on August 17, 2026, clarified consumers will pay no UPI charges.

all_candidates.topic: Is it fair that petrol prices remain stable despite crude decline?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Petrol prices remained steady on August 21, 2026, in major Indian cities despite global oil prices slipping.

all_candidates.topic: Should NTA be held fully accountable for exam errors?
all_candidates.news_anchor: NTA was ordered to fix accountability and audit processes on August 18, 2026, after UGC-NET errors and staff removal.

all_candidates.topic: Should cancelled state exams be immediately re-conducted?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Successful candidates protested Jharkhand exam cancellations outside the secretariat on August 19, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should NTA staff removals improve exam process integrity?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Over 50 NTA staff were removed on August 18, 2026, after UGC-NET errors.

all_candidates.topic: Does AI create more jobs than it eliminates in India?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A report on August 13, 2026, stated India has 2.6 AI hires for every job displaced.

all_candidates.topic: Should government intervene to stabilize rising sugar prices?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India on August 21, 2026, allowed duty-free sugar imports to cool record prices.

all_candidates.topic: Will stricter exam leak penalties deter future malpractices?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India's Lower House on July 29, 2026, passed a Bill with tougher penalties for exam paper leaks.

all_candidates.topic: Does UPI's growing usage need more security measures?
all_candidates.news_anchor: UPI transaction value reached 70% of currency in circulation by July 2026, with new rules aiming for stability and security.

all_candidates.topic: Should E10 petrol be reintroduced for older vehicles?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Reports on August 19, 2026, suggest discussions about reintroducing E10 petrol due to E20 concerns.

all_candidates.topic: Are UPI balance check limits good for user experience?
all_candidates.news_anchor: UPI transaction rules, updated August 13, 2026, include a 50-times daily balance check limit.

all_candidates.topic: Should primary users authorize family for UPI transactions?
all_candidates.news_anchor: UPI rules, updated August 13, 2026, allow primary users to authorize secondary users for UPI payments.

all_candidates.topic: Is the revised NEET UG counselling date beneficial for students?
all_candidates.news_anchor: MCC revised NEET UG 2026 Round 1 result date to August 21, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should new residential buildings mandate EV charging points?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Maharashtra's EV Policy 2025 mandates 100% EV-ready parking in new residential buildings, with an amendment proposed on August 20, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should existing housing societies receive EV charging incentives?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Maharashtra EV Policy 2025 offers incentives to existing housing societies for EV charging, with further amendments proposed on August 20, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is non-extension of DPDP Act deadline fair to businesses?
all_candidates.news_anchor: MeitY Secretary on August 17, 2026, ruled out extending DPDP Act implementation timelines.

all_candidates.topic: Is increasing UPI limit for tax payments a good step?
all_candidates.news_anchor: RBI on August 13, 2026, increased the UPI tax payment limit from ₹1 lakh to ₹5 lakh per transaction.

all_candidates.topic: Should farmers prioritize chemical-free farming for exports?
all_candidates.news_anchor: PM Modi on August 15, 2026, urged farmers to expand chemical-free cultivation for exports.

all_candidates.topic: Should government standardize contract-farming loans nationwide?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Centre on August 17, 2026, asked PSBs, IBA to standardize contract-farming loans.
